framework: Official SpyTest adapter invokes the same individually asserted real-DUT scenarios; collection is not execution

cases.reason: A reviewed known-CVE reference corpus and expected advisory/severity outcomes are still needed. File-only package fixtures prove inventory/delta behavior, not vulnerability recall or new-CVE discovery.

Exact inventory retry/idempotency is covered; repeated real scanner runs and notification deduplication against a reviewed CVE corpus remain unverified. Current unresolved findings must not disappear on a second scan.

cases.limitations: Authenticated device/service synchronization and scoped evidence responses; assessment correctness additionally needs reference-corpus evidence.

cases.reason: Mode/action gates use explicitly synthetic fixtures. Ground-truth assessment coverage for every recommendation type remains unverified.

cases.adaptation: Service failures retain stale results and abstain; they never manufacture CVSS-only safe verdicts or auto-heal instructions.

assertions: one explicitly labelled post-install validation error injected
real package install and downgrade commands
BGP established peers and received-prefix counts
cases.limitations: Healthy baseline execution plus isolated unit regressions; no destructive service/interface/routing fault is injected on lab switches.

assertions: advisory and assisted modes do not auto-install
actual daemon automatically updates only allowlisted harmless fixture
explicitly synthetic non-affected assessment arrives from service
native CLI exports scoped CycloneDX VEX
expiry cannot keep an exemption authoritative
cases.limitations: Full external-schema validation and automatic native file emission are separate gates; current native export is an explicit CLI action.

cases.adaptation: The switch schedules metadata collection and outbound sync; Grype and vulnerability database scheduling run centrally. This case verifies repeated actual collection at configured intervals.

cases.limitations: Package installation, active daemon/restart, real RSS/cgroup/OOM counters and threshold deferral are checked. Boot-time enablement and full image build need their own evidence; no DUT reboot is performed.

cases.reason: All prepared scenarios must actually run and restore state, and uncovered reference-corpus/accuracy/complete quickstart cases must also be resolved before declaring full acceptance.

success_criteria_not_established_by_prep: SC-001 current real end-to-end scan latency
SC-010 completeness of structured security audit logs
